text: This report discusses the award of the tender for the Orangutan Outdoor Exhibit project. The Orangutan Outdoor Exhibit Project is an animal improvement project to upgrade the living conditions, animal behaviour enrichment, animal space and management of the orangutans.
The Toronto Zoo Board of Management: 1. Approved Confidential Attachment 1 attached to the report (February 6, 2020) from the Director, Facilities and Infrastructure, Toronto Zoo.
